units.source_text: 酒过二巡之后，冷泉院遣使送信来了。

en.t: After the wine had gone around twice, Reizei-in sent a messenger with a letter.

units.source_text: 原来今夜宫中游宴忽然作罢，令人颇感遗憾，

en.t: It turned out that the palace banquet planned for that night had suddenly been canceled, which everyone found deeply disappointing,

units.source_text: 因此左大弁红梅、式部大辅，以及其他应有诸人都来到冷泉院。

en.t: and so Kobai, the Major Controller of the Left, the Senior Assistant Minister of Ceremonial, and all the other proper guests had come to Reizei-in.

units.source_text: 闻知夕雾大将等在六条院，冷泉院便派人来邀。

en.t: When Reizei-in heard that General Yugiri and the others were at Rokujo-in, he sent someone to invite them.
